question.en: Critically analyze the role of Special Economic Zones (SEZs) in promoting industrial growth and exports in India.

introduction.en: Special Economic Zones (SEZs) are designated duty-free enclaves treated as foreign territory for trade operations, aimed at boosting exports and attracting foreign investment.
introduction.hi: Special Economic Zones (SEZs) are designated duty-free enclaves treated as foreign territory for trade operations, aimed at boosting exports and attracting foreign investment.

body.en: SEZs have successfully attracted FDI and created employment in sectors like IT and textiles. However, they face challenges such as land acquisition disputes, underutilization of land, and competition from global manufacturing hubs. The shift from tax-based incentives to infrastructure-based support is necessary.
body.hi: SEZs have successfully attracted FDI and created employment in sectors like IT and textiles. However, they face challenges such as land acquisition disputes, underutilization of land, and competition from global manufacturing hubs. The shift from tax-based incentives to infrastructure-based support is necessary.

conclusion.en: To revitalize SEZs, the government should transition to the proposed Development of Enterprise and Service Hubs (DESH) framework to integrate them better with the domestic economy.
conclusion.hi: To revitalize SEZs, the government should transition to the proposed Development of Enterprise and Service Hubs (DESH) framework to integrate them better with the domestic economy.
